title: Eastern Bankshares, Inc. To Join S&P SmallCap 600® Index
summary: Eastern Bankshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: EBC), the holding company of Eastern Bank, today announced that it will be added to the SP SmallCap 600 ® Index, effective prior to the opening of trading on June 22, 2026. The SP SmallCap 600 Index is widely regarded as one of the premiere benchmarks for small-cap U.S. equities. “Our addition to the SP SmallCap 600 Index reflects the strength of our business and continued focus on delivering long-term value for customers and shareholders,” said Denis Sheahan, Chief Executive Officer. “Inclusion in the index enhances Eastern’s visibility among institutional investors and recognizes the significant progress we have made executing our growth strategy since becoming a public company in 2020.” The SP SmallCap 600 Index is maintained by SP Dow Jones Indices and includes companies that meet certain criteria such as financial performance, market capitalization, and liquidity.
